overall_reason: One UI sans (Segoe UI drawn at 1440, from a -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI" stack; system-ui at 375) sets every role, which fits a product component in Operate mode, so TYP-005 does not apply. The list head 'Inbox' (13px/600) sits one pixel above the sender names (12px/600) in the same weight, and the subject line (11.5px) sits half a pixel from the time (11px).

score.reason: T-LADDER fails twice: the head and the names share a weight with a 1px size gap (TYP-020), and 11px and 11.5px are drift (TYP-010); T-LEADING passes at 1.38 to 1.39.

findings.title: Weight steps are clear
findings.evidence: The DOM gives 'Inbox' 13px/600 and 'Maya Chen', 'Jon Park' and 'Ana Ruiz' 12px/600 (01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png, top left).
findings.after: Give the list head a clear step: a larger size from the fixed scale, or names at 500 under a 600 head
findings.why: With one pixel and no weight between them, the head reads as another row instead of the name of the list.

findings.title: One size per kind of element
findings.evidence: Subjects 'Launch checklist', 'Re: pricing page' and 'Q3 board deck' are 11.5px and the times '9:41' are 11px; the small role holds 11, 11.5 and 12px.
findings.after: One secondary step (12px) for subject and time
findings.why: A half-pixel step is drift: it does not read as a choice and only adds a size to maintain.

strengths: Sender names in 600 against subjects in 400 give each row a clear first read.
